deadline.value: Apply by January 15, 2027 for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Near Eastern & Judaic Studies, Social Policy (Heller), History | January 15

gre_general.value: Applicants who have not earned or will not earn a US degree before enrolling must submit the GRE; only US-degree holders are waived.
gre_general.quote: the GRE is required if you have not earned or will not earn a degree from an accredited institution of higher education in the United States prior to enrolling at Brandeis

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: No supervisor agreement is needed to be admitted; a faculty adviser must agree by the end of the first year.
supervisor.quote: By the end of the first year, students must obtain the consent of a computer science faculty member to serve as adviser and dissertation committee chair.

funding.value: Most doctoral students receive a competitive fellowship, a full-tuition scholarship and health insurance for five years.
funding.quote: Most of our doctoral students enroll full-time and receive competitive funding packages.

also.quote: Funding for PhD students includes a competitive fellowship, a full-tuition scholarship, and health insurance benefits for five years.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's degree to apply.
entry_route.quote: You must hold (or be about to earn) a bachelor’s degree from an accredited U.S. or international institution.

notes: Applicants without a US degree must submit the GRE, so this is the one program where the GRE is required for most Indian applicants.
